entities.summary: Ida Magli was an Italian cultural anthropologist, philosopher, feminist, essayist, and journalist. She applied anthropological methods in her research works on Italian and European societies. She also studied women's history by identifying the roots of male domination on women. During the last years of her life, she took critical positions against the unification of Europe.
